title: Frontend Engineer
description:
Zeta is hiring a Frontend Engineer for the customer web experience team.

You will build React applications used by millions of banking customers, own the design system, and work closely with designers on interaction detail.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of React and TypeScript.
- Strong CSS and accessibility fundamentals.
- Experience with build tooling and web performance.

This is a frontend role; backend work is handled by a separate team.
